plans.name: Cedar
plans.description: Low, flat taxes and light regulation. Public support is limited to emergencies; households buy most services for themselves, including health coverage.

plans.name: Alder
plans.description: Every household is guaranteed a minimum income and basic health coverage, paid for by somewhat higher taxes on the upper groups. Otherwise the economy runs much as it does today.

plans.name: Hazel
plans.description: Taxes and public provision are set at the point that lifts the lowest group's income as high as it can be sustained; pushing any further would shrink the economy enough to lower it again.

plans.name: Birch
plans.description: Taxes and pay rules keep the top group's average income at no more than four times the lowest group's. Public services are broad and the same for everyone.
